source: Season batches a production rex library held (2026-10-14), each named for the show's first season, or for several (`Seasons 1-3`, `Season 01 + Season 02 + ...`, which read as season 1), while its files name their own; TMDB's season and episode for each read off TMDB (Railgun 30977, Food Wars 62273, Aria 53787, Bakuman 36041, Demon Slayer 85937: its S2 is the Mugen Train arc's 7, S3 the Entertainment District's 11). rex had stacked every season's E01 on S1E1 as versions of one episode.
